descriptionChirho: Proper noun designating Elam (עֵילָם), the ancient civilization and geographical region east of Mesopotamia (modern southwestern Iran), referenced in prophetic and historical texts (Gen 14:1, 9; Isa 11:11, 21:2, 22:6; Jer 25:25, 49:34-39; Ezek 32:24; Dan 8:2; Ezra 4:9). All three clusters represent the same geographical/national entity across syntactic variation: standalone or with preposition 'in Elam' (S123588), conjunction-prefixed 'and Elam / and from Elam' (S123590), and a ketiv variant possibly reading עוֹלָם 'forever' (S123592). Multilingual evidence uniformly identifies one referent: Spanish 'Elam,' Hindi 'एलाम,' Arabic 'عِيلَامَ,' Korean '엘람,' Swahili 'Elamu.' The ketiv reading in S123592 is a scribal variant that all versions resolve to the same place name.
